changelog:
### New Feature — Address History (Premium)
- Premium users now have a ?? History tab in their dashboard
- Shows all temp email addresses generated while logged in (last 90 days)
- Click any row to browse its inbox and read individual emails
- Delete history entries individually
- Paginated list (20 per page)
- Free users see an upgrade prompt with lock icon on the tab

### Technical
- purge_expired() now preserves premium user address records for 90 days (purges emails only to save storage)
- Anonymous guest addresses still purged immediately on expiry
- 4 new AJAX actions: tmpmp_get_address_history, tmpmp_get_history_emails, tmpmp_get_history_email_body, tmpmp_delete_history_address
